game.title: Flight of the Amazon Queen
game.variant: Floppy DOS English (queen.1, 22677657 bytes, md5 979a3395...), as detected by ScummVM as Floppy/DOS/English

pack.notes: DRAFT for review, rooms 1 to 5 only. Hand survey from the Queen probe dump and one window capture per room. Queen has no chapters; chapter 1 is a placeholder so the v1 schema validates. Hotspot keys are the room-relative noun numbers from the probe (PROBE OBJ n), not the global object index.

1.name: Plane cabin
1.short: Inside the wrecked plane. Waterlogged seats are on the left, crates in the middle, and a hatch on the right.
1.long: The cabin of the plane, seen along its length. On the left, red seats stand in water. In the middle, wooden crates are strapped down, and Sparky stands beside them. A green duffle bag lies on the floor in front. Faye stands on the right, next to a hatch with a window in it.
1.note: Engine room code C1. Draft, not reviewed.

6.label: hatch out to the river
6.note: Engine name hatch, g=6. A closed door at game start (exit=closed->2); it must be opened first. Opening it changes only the object (entry -8 to 8), not a gs[] word, so v1 opensWhen cannot express it. Look line is the generic 'It looks nice'.

1.description: A green duffle bag on the floor, in front of the crates.

2.name: River beside the plane
2.short: Outside the plane, which sits in a river. Its hatch is in the middle, lily pads float below, and piranhas swim on the left.
2.long: The side of the plane fills the top of the screen, with AMAZON QUEEN painted on the left. Its round hatch is in the middle. Below, the river runs across the screen. Piranhas swim on the left. A giant lily pad floats under the hatch, with more lily pads to the right. A broken propeller lies in the water, right of centre.
2.note: Engine room code C2. The capture shows the hatch open because the probe jumps straight in. Smoke (5) is a hotspot at the top right but is not clear in the capture, so it is left out of the room text.

2.label: hatch back into the plane
2.note: Engine name inside airplane, g=8. Box covers the hatch and the right of the fuselage.

3.name: Riverbank
3.short: A sandy bank by the river. The wrecked plane is in the top left corner, Faye and Sparky stand on the bank, and a woman sits on a rock on the right.
3.long: The river fills the top left, with the wrecked plane at its far end in the corner. Faye and Sparky stand on a sandy bank, left of centre. Rocks lie at the bottom left, where a path leads off. On the right, a woman with long black hair sits on a rock among the jungle plants. Thick jungle covers the top right, where a second path leads in.

4.name: Rope bridge
4.short: A dirt path above a river. A rope bridge crosses at the top left, a banana tree stands right of centre, and a banana lies on the ground.
4.long: Mountains rise behind a misty valley across the top. On the left, a rope bridge crosses the river, with a support rope at its left end. The river runs down the middle of the screen. A banana tree stands right of centre, and a single banana lies on the ground at the bottom right. A dirt path runs along the right side, and the way back leads off at the bottom left.
4.note: Engine room code C4. The only engine exit is the path back to room 3.

5.name: Jungle path
5.short: A jungle path climbs from the foreground to the top of the screen. A stream runs on the left, and a vine hangs from a tree on the right.
5.long: Big trees and ferns crowd both sides. On the left, a stream runs behind the trees. In the middle, a dirt path climbs from the foreground to the top of the screen, where it leads on. On the right, a thin vine hangs from a tree almost to the ground. The way back is through the plants at the bottom left.
5.note: Engine room code C5. Something red and yellow hangs at the bottom of the vine in the capture; it has no hotspot of its own and is not described.
